props.description: Shape of the edges: straight, smooth (monotone) or steps

props.description:
Also follows in-place mutations of nested data (`series[0].data.push()`);

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend; shown by default when several series have a name

props.name: crosshair
props.description: Vertical guide line following the pointer

props.name: interaction
props.description: Zoom (Ctrl / ⌘ + wheel, pinch), pan (drag), double-click reset and keyboard navigation; `false` makes the chart static (default `true`)

props.name: labels
props.description: Overrides of the built-in texts of the `locale`

props.name: renderer
props.description: Backend of the data layer: `auto` tries WebGPU, then WebGL2, then WebGL, then Canvas2D (default `auto`)

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the chart; numbers are pixels (default `100%`)

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the chart (the legend included); numbers are pixels, strings any CSS length

props.name: series
props.description: Data series (replace the array or a `data` array to update the chart)

props.name: padding
props.description: Space around the plot area, in pixels

props.name: palette
props.description: Series colors (defaults to the `--chart-series-1..8` CSS variables, then the theme colors)

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale of the texts and numbers the engine writes (tooltip, axes, accessible names); the page language by default

<script setup lang="ts">
// A forecast with its uncertainty: the band (`y0` - `y`) widens with the
// horizon; the actual values and the forecast are lines (`type: "line"`).
import { computed } from "vue";
import { useI18n } from "minerva-design/vue";
import { RangeAreaChart } from "minerva-design/vue/charts";

const TEXT = {
  en: { actual: "Actual", forecast: "Forecast", band: "80 % interval" },
  zh: { actual: "实际", forecast: "预测", band: "80% 置信区间" },
  ja: { actual: "実績", forecast: "予測", band: "80% 予測区間" },
  fr: { actual: "Réel", forecast: "Prévision", band: "Intervalle à 80 %" },
};
const MONTHS = {
  en: [
    "Jan",
    "Feb",
    "Mar",
    "Apr",
    "May",
    "Jun",
    "Jul",
    "Aug",
    "Sep",
    "Oct",
    "Nov",
    "Dec",
  ],
  zh: [
    "1月",
    "2月",
    "3月",
    "4月",
    "5月",
    "6月",
    "7月",
    "8月",
    "9月",
    "10月",
    "11月",
    "12月",
  ],
  ja: [
    "1月",
    "2月",
    "3月",
    "4月",
    "5月",
    "6月",
    "7月",
    "8月",
    "9月",
    "10月",
    "11月",
    "12月",
  ],
  fr: [
    "janv.",
    "févr.",
    "mars",
    "avr.",
    "mai",
    "juin",
    "juil.",
    "août",
    "sept.",
    "oct.",
    "nov.",
    "déc.",
  ],
};

const ACTUAL = [120, 132, 128, 141, 150, 158];
const FORECAST = [158, 163, 169, 172, 178, 185, 190];

const { language } = useI18n();
const months = computed(() => MONTHS[language.value] ?? MONTHS.en);
const series = computed(() => {
  const text = TEXT[language.value] ?? TEXT.en;
  return [
    {
      name: text.band,
      data: FORECAST.map((y, i) => ({
        x: months.value[5 + i],
        y0: y - 4 * i,
        y: y + 4 * i,
      })),
    },
    {
      name: text.actual,
      type: "line" as const,
      data: ACTUAL.map((y, i) => ({ x: months.value[i], y })),
    },
    {
      name: text.forecast,
      type: "line" as const,
      lineWidth: 1,
      data: FORECAST.map((y, i) => ({ x: months.value[5 + i], y })),
    },
  ];
});
</script>

<template>
  <RangeAreaChart
    :series="series"
    :x-axis="{ type: 'category', categories: months }"
    :height="300"
  />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
// Daily minimum and maximum temperatures as a band, the average as a line;
// `curve="linear"` keeps the measured values at the corners.
import { computed } from "vue";
import { useI18n } from "minerva-design/vue";
import { RangeAreaChart } from "minerva-design/vue/charts";

const TEXT = {
  en: { range: "Min – max", mean: "Average" },
  zh: { range: "最低 – 最高", mean: "平均" },
  ja: { range: "最低 – 最高", mean: "平均" },
  fr: { range: "Min – max", mean: "Moyenne" },
};
const DAYS = {
  en: ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"],
  zh: ["周一", "周二", "周三", "周四", "周五", "周六", "周日"],
  ja: ["月", "火", "水", "木", "金", "土", "日"],
  fr: ["lun.", "mar.", "mer.", "jeu.", "ven.", "sam.", "dim."],
};

const LOW = [8, 9, 7, 11, 13, 12, 10];
const HIGH = [16, 18, 15, 21, 24, 22, 19];

const { language } = useI18n();
const series = computed(() => {
  const text = TEXT[language.value] ?? TEXT.en;
  const days = DAYS[language.value] ?? DAYS.en;
  return [
    {
      name: text.range,
      data: days.map((x, i) => ({ x, y0: LOW[i], y: HIGH[i] })),
    },
    {
      name: text.mean,
      type: "line" as const,
      data: days.map((x, i) => ({ x, y: (LOW[i] + HIGH[i]) / 2 })),
    },
  ];
});
const yAxis = { format: (value: number) => `${value} °C` };
</script>

<template>
  <RangeAreaChart
    :series="series"
    curve="linear"
    :x-axis="{ type: 'category' }"
    :y-axis="yAxis"
    :height="280"
  />
</template>

translationResources.title: Range area chart
translationResources.description: Bands between a lower and an upper edge: confidence intervals, forecasts, min-max ranges and percentile fans.

forecast.title: Forecast with confidence bands
forecast.description: Each point of an area sets its lower edge with y0: the 80% and 95% intervals widen with the horizon, the history and the forecast are lines; lineWidth: 0 hides the edges of the bands.

temperature.title: Daily minimum and maximum
temperature.description: A year of daily temperature ranges with the seasonal normal: the tooltip shows both ends of the band, Ctrl / ⌘ + wheel zooms on single days.

fan.title: Percentile fan
fan.description: Nested bands of the 5th-95th and 25th-75th percentiles of a latency around its median: busy hours widen the distribution.

price-range.title: Trading range
price-range.description: The low-high range of every trading day in a band and the close as a line, a light alternative to candlesticks.

anomaly-band.title: Anomaly detection
anomaly-band.description: The expected traffic ± k standard deviations as a band, the measured values as a line, and the points outside the band as a type: "scatter" series in the danger color. The RadioGroup sets k and the output counts the anomalies.

bid-ask.title: Live bid–ask spread
bid-ask.description: A setInterval adds a quote every 500 ms to a one-minute window and is cleared on pause and on unmount. The band goes from the bid to the ask with curve="step", the mid price is a line, and the output shows the latest spread in basis points.

climate-scenarios.title: Emission scenarios
climate-scenarios.description: Two overlapping bands with their medians continue an observed record to 2100; y line annotations mark the 1.5 °C and 2 °C limits, and clicking a legend item hides a series.

ab-test.title: A/B test confidence
ab-test.description: The cumulative lift of variant B over A, day by day, inside its confidence interval. The RadioGroup changes the confidence level, a y line marks zero, and a rect annotation shades the days from which the interval stays above it.

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: Monthly temperature ranges as a band (y0 to y) with the mean as a line; locale follows the app language.

forecast.description: A band from y0 to y widens with the horizon; the actual values and the forecast are line series.

temperature.title: Daily temperature range
temperature.description: Minimum and maximum of each day as a band, the average as a line; straight edges keep the measured values.

props.height: Height of the chart, the legend included: pixels or any CSS length
props.options: Other engine options (axes, legend, tooltip, palette, format…) merged with the element's own properties; property only
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected

events.minerva-hover: The hovered (or keyboard-focused) points changed; detail: { x, xLabel, items }, null when nothing is hovered
events.minerva-point-click: A point or a bar was clicked; detail: { x, xLabel, items }
events.minerva-plot-click: The plot area was clicked where there is no point; detail: { x, y } in data coordinates
events.minerva-zoom: The user zoomed or panned; detail: { x, y } (the visible ranges)
events.minerva-renderer-change: The backend is ready, or fell back after a GPU loss; detail: { renderer }

methods.getView: Visible range, null before the engine is created
methods.getRenderer: Backend in use (webgpu, webgl2, webgl, canvas2d), null until ready
